title: Round Floral Pin Holder
description: One compact floral arranging pin holder: a grounded bevelled solid circular base with thirty-seven separate, fully seated upright faceted pins in three concentric hexagonal-count rings and a central pin. Every pin has a real narrow tapered end with a small closed flat tip, not a zero-area vertex. The complete tool is newly authored as a whole object, not separated from a floral scene or a resized display bucket. Thirty-eight closed editable meshes, two opaque untextured PBR materials, no flowers or accessories. Metres, Z up, centred grounded sole. A static visual asset only: no actual sharpness, stem-holding force, mass, manufacture, water resistance or safe handling is certified; no hidden sockets or fastening mechanism is represented.
